notes.title: New update and explanation
notes.content:
Hi guys,

Well, I owe you explanations, to all, for this break in the updates of the game ...
I had a lot of health concerns, after my father died before the game was released, and I did not think I'd have that much trouble 1 year after his death ... But the spirit got the better of me I had a lot of worries. I had to treat myself and today it is better, that is why I repprends the updates of the game.


So for 1 month I took the game as a whole, to see the imperfections and tried to bring a new eye on this one.
I quickly realized that the game was not really playable ... And so I decided to redo the whole game (keeping the same engine and style).

The game is in real time (as since its release in BETA version) will be some changes but primarily to manage the variables and improve your ship.

I can show you today 3 pictures of the new game. The system to choose its destination will change slightly and the O² / Food / Payment system crew members will also change.


[url=http://www.casimages.com/i/170328102333451767.jpg.html][img]http://nsa37.casimages.com/img/2017/03/28/170328102333451767.jpg[/img][/url]


[url=http://www.casimages.com/i/17032810233717125.jpg.html][img]http://nsa37.casimages.com/img/2017/03/28/17032810233717125.jpg[/img][/url]


[url=http://www.casimages.com/i/170328102337657389.jpg.html][img]http://nsa37.casimages.com/img/2017/03/28/170328102337657389.jpg[/img][/url]

For now I can not tell you words when this update will come out .. It will include the crew management system, the O² / food / fuel and many other things ... It will be enough complete and will be monitored and improved in the coming months.

See you soon on TLE !

notes.title: New patch BETA 0.4
notes.content:
Hello guy's,

I'll leave a message for you statements that the new patch will be released soon. There are a lot of changes and additions.

- One big change is that now you are going to die. What will make the game more complicated !

- This change is also accompanied by a new way of calculating to define the characteristics of the enemy. 

- The life of the player was also increased.

- New way of targeting for attack enemies, more complicated to learn, but more dynamic in combat.

- The level and player progression has been activated!

- Be careful because now you'll have moving asteroids, be careful not to hit them !

- The system of "sector" in been completely redesigned. You now have 10 different sectors (sector 1 easy, sector 10 difficult).
Other features will be added to the sectors in the next update.

- The final boss battle with now 3 phases. Take care ! The game is not for the weak.

- Some enemy does not appear in the first sector, not to frustrate the player.

See soon guy's and good Game !

notes.title: Official Release BETA 0.2 and website
notes.content:
Hello guy's :D


Today I have many words to you...

1) -   First, here are the new website of the game. There are all new and even "spoils" to come. The website aims to share more with you and you can ask questions and leave comments in connection with the game.
    -   You have a section "contact us" for you to send me email if you encounter any problems arise on occasion, or bugs in the game.

[url=http://jemyjan01.wixsite.com/thelightempire] Website "The Light Empire" [/url]

2) -   The second part is much bigger. 
    -   The BETA 0.2 officially released for EVERYONE.
Some additions and major changes have been made since the Alpha version!
Here is a list of changes :
[list]
    [*]The game is entirely in real time
    [*]The skills system was completely redesigned.
    [*]A system of "new game +" was included
    [*]You will keep your money, and other items from one party to another if you can win.
    [*]A new ship creation system, much simpler and more subtle, especially as you your new parts.
    [*]You will have access to different sectors of the galaxy, which will have an impact on what you find ..
    [*]A new weapons purchase system, and a new space station.
    [*]The game may end in the current state. (If you get there ...)
[/list]

*The version is still only the BETA, and therefore does not include all features.*

If you encounter any bugs, problems, or if you have suggestions, please go to the website, in the "Contact / bugs", you can access it via the game menu.

Hope you like the game, the updates are already planned in the coming weeks!

I count on you to get feedback to improve the game!

See soon

notes.title: Total game change
notes.content:
Hello guys, 

I come to you after a long time waiting for you advertise a good (or bad) news for you about the game.

The reason why the game has not been updated, is that I was not happy with the way that take the game after its release. Too much similarity with "FTL" and many people who complained about the interface of the game.

I decided, after much thought, that the game was going to take a turn. I can unveil the outlines of the game.

- The game happens in real time
- You get access to a vast universe (infinite)
- The universe is divided into area. (Large or small)
- As in the old game, your communication and radars will be blurred. You will advance to the blind in the universe.
- The interface is clean, there will be less of statistics to know, while keeping a deep game.
- You can always create your own ship, but with an interface much more convenient and simple.
- The graphics of the vessels will change (enemies and allies)
- The choice will be taken in real time.

I apologize for keeping you waiting so long, but I did not like the game as it was. And you either (for the majority) 

So I decided to listen to you and change the game in depth so that it is an identity.

Now I have to get to work (it has already started) I will keep you informed on the evolution of the update, which could change everything for you !

notes.title: [PATCH] 1.2.2 Attacks and Diseases System
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Here is the update for the colony system. You will now have attacks by space pirates, and disease to manage.

[u]Here is how to manage events[/u] : 

- Attacks : Attacks by space pirates will be based on the general level of the colony and by the number of settlers. So at first you don't risk anything. Beware when you go to develop your colony. You will need defenses.

- Diseases : Diseases appear depending on the number of settlers. Longer you have of settlers more likely you are to have diseases. Hospital reduces the chance that the disease is fatal. Consider improving the Hospital.

The frequency at which appear the attacks, and disease, can be changed later if this is too easy or too difficult to manage.

For the moment the events can be triggered every time you get on the map of the universe. Don't worry, at first it does not appear coming!

So, good game all,

See soon..

notes.title: [UPDATE 2/2] Colony system
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Today I just show you the progress and changes, about the colony system.

Key features (definitive) that it will be :

[list]
    [*][u]1 planet colonizable[/u] : In the first version I had thought to offer several planet to colonize. But on reflection, I go back on my decision, and propose only colonized planet. However it will have advantages in the possibility of improvement.
    [*][u]Construction materials[/u] : To improve your colony, you have to build and improve production buildings, (in addition to farms and extractors). There will sawmills, stone quarries and mineral, and foundry.
    [*][u]Important materials[/u] : Each material (wood, stone, ore) will be important for improving your colony. Make also evolve the center of your colony, otherwise you can't you develop.
    [*][u]Different defense[/u] : To defend your colony of pirates, you'll be able to improve several defense buildings. You will have the infantry, the artillery, and aviation. Each level provides a fixed value of defense. But beware, during an attack, you win or lose, you might lose the infantry during the battle, and thus losing infantry level (and losing defense value). So remember to regularly look at your defense to prepare for all possible to assaults.

    [*][u]Maternity[/u] : For the production of settlers, you have to improve your motherhood. Each level maternity produce settlers (equal to the level of maternity). 
    [*][u]Generate money[/u] : Your colony will produce money, if you install a trading post. But be careful because in return, you will lose resources. (You have to sell something to earn money ...)
[/list]

notes.title: [UPDATE 1/2] Colony System
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Today I come to talk about the next update, which will be on the colony system.

As you know, you can colonize a planet to you to furnish fuel, and food.
But the system is not at all advanced.

Here are the next possibility, there will be in the update :

[list]
    [*]Four planets to colonize (MAX)
    [*]Each planet can provide fuel and food. (With varying degrees of efficiency)
    [*]You will have to manage the settlers, and assign work.
    [*]Buildings construction system.
    [*]Manage defense capability of the colony and building care center to resist disease.
    [*]Overall level of your colony
[/list]

Specifically, when you will want to build a building, it will be shown the "number of jumps" it will take to build it.

A jump will be counted each time you leave your world map, or you will use the "explore galaxy" 
So you will have to manage your farm, and your mines for the production of fuel and food.

But also building construction, to protect your colony. Because once in space, you can not return to defend all your colonies. If the enemy managed to win the battle, you will not lose your colony, but you will lose the settlers, and perhaps the level of buildings.

You will also have to build medical centers to treat your disease settlers otherwise you lose too.

Each colony built can't be destroyed. So do the right choice before building one.

Each colony can generate money ($), it will depend on his level and its current settlers.

I don't have a release date of the update, but feel free to ask me questions, I'll be there to meet them.

See soon, thanks.
